name: Training Core
description: BC pretraining, DPPO fine-tuning logic, and mathematical utilities (PPO objective, Gaussian log-prob, diffusion log-variance, replay buffer).

name: Neural Networks
description: PyTorch model architectures for the diffusion policy actor and value critic, including sinusoidal positional embeddings.

name: Environment
description: Gymnasium environment wrappers that handle action chunking, observation/action normalization, and reward scaling for diffusion policy rollouts.

name: Data Pipeline
description: Standalone script for downloading Minari expert demonstrations and converting them into the training format required by behavior cloning.

name: Evaluation & Visualization
description: Top-level evaluation utilities for comparing BC and DPPO checkpoints, running rollouts, and recording comparison videos.

name: Project Support
description: Documentation, entry-point notebook, trained model checkpoints, and auto-generated metadata files.
